subtype: story-prescribed balance-based coverage check conflicts with the stateless invariant
severity: potential-low (carried by CODE-002; do not double-count)
specText: story-002 Flow step 5: "Skip if `IERC20(token).balanceOf(this) == 0`. Otherwise, if `!routes[token].configured`, revert `RouteNotConfigured(token)`."  versus  src/CLAUDE.md: "Public, stateless between calls ... The contract holds no balances between calls."
specSource: story-002 doc Technical Details > Flow; src/CLAUDE.md Design decisions
actualBehavior: The implementation follows the story: it acts on the raw balanceOf, not on what SYA delivered in this call. A 1-wei donation of a non-delivering strategy's token makes every harvest revert, either through RouteNotConfigured or through a Router NG dust revert.
deviation: Faithful to story-002. The story's balance-based rule assumes the 'holds no balances' invariant, which any outsider can break by donating tokens, so the story's own mechanism enables the DoS.
law1Assessment: Story-level root of a liveness griefing vector (no fund loss). The fix has to change the story's rule, for example selling only the claim's balance delta or applying a dust threshold.
label: F-03
note: Faithfulness cross-ref carried on its parent finding; not a separate ledger entry (not double-counted). Must appear in submissions/spec-conformance.md.
